title: Drug firms’ secret data supercharge AI protein models
title_zh: 制药公司机密数据为 AI 蛋白质模型注入强大动力
abstract: An AI system trained on more than 20,000 protein structures from pharmaceutical companies outperforms AlphaFold-like models that use only public data.
abstract_zh: 一套基于制药公司提供的 20,000 多种蛋白质结构训练的 AI 系统，性能优于仅使用公开数据的 AlphaFold 类模型。
snippet: An AI system trained on more than 20,000 protein structures from pharmaceutical companies outperforms AlphaFold-like models that use only public data.
